rule.statement: A prayer for the invalidation of a deed is not repugnant to Section 35(1) of the Civil Procedure Code if it flows from the same cause of action as the main relief prayed.
rule.supporting_quote: Therefore, the said prayer is not repugnant to Section 35(1) of the Civil Procedure Code.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 35(1) of the Civil Procedure Code
